entries.en: The host shortened his after-dinner speech when the lights began to flicker.
entries.zh: 灯光开始闪烁时，主人缩短了晚餐后的讲话。

entries.meaningZh: 晚间半正式社交场合穿的〔服饰〕
entries.en: She packed an after-five dress for the reception on Friday.
entries.zh: 她把一条适合晚间半正式社交场合的连衣裙装进行李，准备参加星期五的招待会。

entries.en: Their after-sales service included a visit from a technician.
entries.zh: 他们的售后服务包括一次技术员上门服务。

entries.en: He compared the after-tax income from the two hypothetical job offers.
entries.zh: 他比较了两个假设的工作邀约所带来的税后收入。

entries.en: Our after-work walk ended at a small cafe near the station.
entries.zh: 我们下班后散步，最后走到了车站附近的一家小咖啡馆。

entries.en: The engineer inspected the aftercooled compressor before the demonstration began.
entries.zh: 工程师在演示开始前检查了那台后冷却式压缩机。

entries.en: An afterdinner concert kept the guests in the drawing room until midnight.
entries.zh: 一场正餐后的音乐会让客人们在客厅一直待到午夜。

entries.en: The band lost its afterhours rehearsal space when the building closed.
entries.zh: 大楼关闭后，乐队失去了业余排练场地。

entries.en: The aftermentioned conditions apply to every item in this catalogue.
entries.zh: 后述条件适用于本目录中的每一件商品。

entries.en: She contacted the aftersales department about the missing replacement part.
entries.zh: 她就缺少替换零件一事联系了售后部门。

entries.en: The library offered an afterschool chess club in the upstairs room.
entries.zh: 图书馆在楼上的房间开设了课外国际象棋俱乐部。

entries.en: She left a tube of aftersun beside the beach towels.
entries.zh: 她把一管晒后护肤霜留在了沙滩毛巾旁。

entries.en: The spreadsheet shows aftertax earnings for three fictional households.
entries.zh: 电子表格列出了三个虚构家庭的税后收入。

entries.en: The novel contrasts afterwar hopes with memories of the fighting.
entries.zh: 小说将战后的希望与对战斗的回忆作了对比。

entries.en: They cancelled their afterwork drinks to finish the urgent repair.
entries.zh: 他们取消了下班后的小酌聚会，以完成紧急维修。

entries.en: The mechanic stored the spare rope in the aftmost locker.
entries.zh: 机械师把备用绳放进了最靠近船尾的储物柜。

entries.en: The pathologist marked the aganglionic segment on the diagram.
entries.zh: 病理学家在图上标出了无神经节细胞的那一段。

entries.en: They poured the agarized medium into sterile dishes before it set.
entries.zh: 他们在琼脂化培养基凝固之前将其倒入无菌培养皿。

entries.en: The geologist sampled an agatiferous layer exposed beside the track.
entries.zh: 地质学家从路旁露出的一层含玛瑙岩层中采了样。

entries.en: She stood agazed at the doorway after hearing the sudden crash.
entries.zh: 听到突如其来的巨响后，她惊恐地站在门口。

entries.en: The librarian selected age-appropriate stories for the visiting school group.
entries.zh: 图书馆员为来访的学生团体挑选了适龄故事。

entries.en: She distrusted the advertisement's promises about an age-defying cream.
entries.zh: 她不相信广告对一款抗衰老面霜所作的承诺。

entries.en: The festival revived an age-long tradition that the village had nearly forgotten.
entries.zh: 这场庆典恢复了村子几乎已经遗忘的一项悠久传统。

entries.en: The researcher compared the results from two age-matched groups.
entries.zh: 研究人员比较了两个年龄相匹配组的结果。

entries.en: The report presents age-specific figures rather than a single overall average.
entries.zh: 报告列出了针对特定年龄群的数据，而不是一个总体平均数。

entries.en: An agender participant asked the organisers to remove the gender question.
entries.zh: 一位无性别认同的参加者要求组织者删去性别问题。

entries.en: An agent-based model helped us explore movement through the crowded hall.
entries.zh: 一个基于主体的模型帮助我们探索拥挤大厅中的人员移动。

entries.en: She analysed the agentive suffix in the exercise's final example.
entries.zh: 她分析了练习最后一个例子中的施事后缀。

entries.en: The team chose agentless monitoring for the temporary test environment.
entries.zh: 团队为临时测试环境选择了无代理监控。

entries.en: The simulation showed a strong ageostrophic current near the boundary.
entries.zh: 模拟显示边界附近有一股强烈的非地转流。

entries.en: The conservator applied an agglutinant to the torn paper.
entries.zh: 文物修复人员在纸张的破损处涂上了粘合剂。

entries.en: The geologist distinguished two aggradational phases in the river's history.
entries.zh: 地质学家区分出了这条河流演变史中的两个沉积加高阶段。

entries.en: The model reproduced the particles' aggregational behaviour near the wall.
entries.zh: 模型再现了颗粒在壁面附近的聚集行为。

entries.en: The pamphlet's agitational language made the committee reluctant to circulate it.
entries.zh: 小册子中鼓动性的语言使委员会不愿散发它。

entries.en: The anatomical drawing depicts an aglossal mouth in cross section.
entries.zh: 这幅解剖图以剖面展示了一个无舌的口腔。

entries.en: The medical illustration shows agminate nodules beneath a patch of skin.
entries.zh: 医学插图显示一块皮肤下方有一些聚集的结节。

entries.en: The exhibit includes a model of an agnathous fish.
entries.zh: 展览中有一个无颚类鱼的模型。

entries.en: The researcher transcribed the agrammatic speech before coding the recording.
entries.zh: 研究人员先将存在语法失能现象的言语转写下来，再对录音进行编码。

entries.en: The experiment filmed floating droplets in an agravic environment.
entries.zh: 实验拍摄了失重环境中漂浮的液滴。

entries.en: We followed the agreed-on route despite the longer walking distance.
entries.zh: 尽管步行距离更长，我们还是沿着商定的路线走。

entries.en: The botanist recorded agrestial plants along the edge of the wheat field.
entries.zh: 植物学家记录了麦田边缘那些在农田中野生的植物。

entries.en: The library moved its old volume on agriology to the historical collection.
entries.zh: 图书馆把那本原始人类学旧著调到了历史文献藏区。

entries.en: The shipment contained an agro-chemical that was missing from the invoice.
entries.zh: 这批货中有一种发票上未列出的农用化学品。

entries.en: Her thesis uses household interviews to examine agro-ecological planning.
entries.zh: 她的论文利用家庭访谈探讨农业生态学规划。

entries.en: The council debated an agro-industrial project proposed for the old warehouse site.
entries.zh: 议会讨论了一个拟建在旧仓库地块上的农业和工业项目。

entries.en: The map divides the valley into three agroclimatic zones.
entries.zh: 这张地图把山谷划分为三个农业气候区。

entries.en: We compared the agroecological assumptions behind the two land-use plans.
entries.zh: 我们比较了两份土地利用方案背后的农业生态学假设。

entries.en: The exhibition traced the town's agroindustrial past through tools and photographs.
entries.zh: 展览通过工具和照片追溯了小镇的农业和工业历史。

entries.en: The farmers requested an agrometeorological report before planning the harvest schedule.
entries.zh: 农民们在安排收获日程之前要求提供一份农业气象报告。

entries.en: The survey recorded agrophilous insects along the newly ploughed field's boundary.
entries.zh: 调查记录了新翻耕农田边界处的栖耕地昆虫。

entries.en: The college added an agrotechnical workshop to its summer training programme.
entries.zh: 学院在暑期培训计划中增设了一个农业技术实践班。

entries.en: The novel follows an agued traveller seeking shelter during a storm.
entries.zh: 小说讲述了一位患疟疾的旅行者在暴风雨中寻找栖身之所的经历。

entries.en: The chamber's lights followed an ahemeral cycle of twenty hours.
entries.zh: 腔室的灯光按照不足一天的二十小时周期运行。

entries.en: A model of an ahermatypic coral stood beside the aquarium entrance.
entries.zh: 水族馆入口旁放着一个非造礁珊瑚的模型。

entries.en: The critic objected to the film's ahistoric treatment of the conflict.
entries.zh: 评论家反对影片脱离历史地处理那场冲突。

entries.en: The ahungered travellers welcomed the smell of bread from the kitchen.
entries.zh: 饥饿的旅行者们闻到厨房飘出的面包香气，十分高兴。

entries.en: Her aidant presence steadied him throughout the difficult conversation.
entries.zh: 在那场艰难的谈话中，她在场给予支持，使他始终保持镇定。

entries.en: A seminar on AIDS-related research drew students from several departments.
entries.zh: 一场关于艾滋病相关研究的研讨课吸引了多个系的学生。

entries.meaningZh: 用轰炸机投原子弹的〔旧用〕
entries.en: The historian compared two bomber-based air-atomic strategy papers from the archive.
entries.zh: 历史学家比较了档案馆中两份有关用轰炸机投原子弹的战略文件。

entries.en: An air-cushioned vehicle glided across the demonstration pool toward the ramp.
entries.zh: 一辆气垫支承的交通工具滑过演示水池，驶向坡道。

entries.en: The museum displayed a simplified model of an air-defense radar station.
entries.zh: 博物馆展出了一个防空雷达站的简化模型。

entries.en: The mechanic disconnected the hose from the air-driven drill.
entries.zh: 机械师从气动钻上断开了软管。

entries.en: The exercise exposed a problem in the team's air-ground coordination.
entries.zh: 演习暴露了这个团队在陆空协同方面的一个问题。

entries.en: The display case contained a small model of an air-launched missile.
entries.zh: 展柜里有一个空中发射导弹的小模型。

entries.en: My air-minded friend spent the afternoon exploring the aviation museum.
entries.zh: 我那位热心航空的朋友花了一下午参观航空博物馆。

entries.en: The map showed the air-mobile unit's planned landing area.
entries.zh: 地图标出了那支空中机动部队计划使用的着陆区域。

entries.en: A loose fitting interrupted the operation of the air-operated valve.
entries.zh: 一个松动的接头打断了气动阀的运行。

entries.en: The carpenter borrowed an air-powered nailer for the workshop demonstration.
entries.zh: 木匠借了一把气动射钉枪，用于车间演示。

entries.en: She replaced the damaged gasket to restore the container's air-proof seal.
entries.zh: 她更换了损坏的密封垫，以恢复容器的气密性。

entries.en: The diary describes a family waiting inside an air-raid shelter.
entries.zh: 日记描述了一家人在防空袭掩体里等待的情景。

entries.en: The engineer adjusted the air-spaced capacitor before repeating the measurement.
entries.zh: 工程师调整了空气绝缘电容器，然后重新测量。

entries.en: An airbound pump delayed the demonstration until a technician arrived.
entries.zh: 一台被气体阻塞的泵使演示推迟，直到技术员赶来。

entries.en: The new lid formed an airfast closure around the container's rim.
entries.zh: 新盖子沿着容器口形成了不透风的封闭。

entries.en: She chose the airiest room in the house for her painting studio.
entries.zh: 她选了房子里最通风的房间作为画室。

entries.en: The instructor compared airmobile tactics with the ground unit's original plan.
entries.zh: 教官将空中机动部队的战术与地面部队的原计划进行了比较。

entries.en: She dismissed the airy-fairy proposal and asked for a practical budget.
entries.zh: 她否决了那个空想的提案，要求拿出切实可行的预算。

entries.en: The architect sketched an aisled hall with windows along both sides.
entries.zh: 建筑师画了一座有狭长通路、两侧带窗的大厅草图。

entries.en: The archive received a collection of Alabamian newspapers from a private donor.
entries.zh: 档案馆收到了一位私人捐赠者提供的一批阿拉巴马州报纸。

entries.en: The log showed an alarm-free interval between the two scheduled tests.
entries.zh: 日志显示，两次预定测试之间有一段无报警的时间。

entries.en: The alarmable horse shied away when the metal gate slammed.
entries.zh: 金属大门砰地关上时，那匹容易受惊的马躲闪开了。

entries.en: The entomologist labelled the alatate tibia in the enlarged drawing.
entries.zh: 昆虫学家在放大图中标注了具有侧翼的胫节。

entries.en: The illustrator shaded the albugineous membrane around the organ.
entries.zh: 插画师给器官周围的白膜画上了阴影。

entries.en: The guide's chapter on alcidine birds included several coastal sketches.
entries.zh: 这本指南有关海雀科鸟类的章节中有几幅海岸素描。

entries.en: Several alcids appeared in the observer's sketch of the rocky ledge.
entries.zh: 观察者描绘岩架的草图上出现了几只海雀科鸟。

entries.en: We served alcohol-free cocktails alongside the drinks on the main table.
entries.zh: 我们在主桌上的饮料旁也提供了不含酒精的鸡尾酒。

entries.en: At rehearsal, the musicians argued about the aleatoric section.
entries.zh: 排练时，音乐家们就那个偶然性乐段争论起来。

entries.en: Her alembicated prose made a simple event difficult to follow.
entries.zh: 她过分精炼的文字使一件简单的事情也难以理解。

entries.en: An alepidote fish lay beside the ruler in the illustration.
entries.zh: 插图中，一条无鳞鱼躺在直尺旁边。

entries.en: The historical manual described the mixture as alexeteric without giving evidence.
entries.zh: 那本历史手册将这种混合物描述为具有解毒作用，却没有提供证据。

entries.en: The inventory lists an alexipharmic in a locked wooden cabinet.
entries.zh: 清单记载，一个上锁的木柜中存放着一种解毒药。

entries.en: The geologist kept the alferric soil samples in a separate tray.
entries.zh: 地质学家把含铝铁氧化物的土样单独放在一只托盘里。

entries.en: The study excluded algogenic substances from the final formulation.
entries.zh: 这项研究在最终配方中排除了产生疼痛的物质。

entries.en: The researcher watched algophagous larvae feeding under the microscope.
entries.zh: 研究人员在显微镜下观察以藻类为食的幼虫进食。

entries.en: The students compared the algous samples collected from the two tanks.
entries.zh: 学生们比较了从两个水槽收集的藻类样本。

entries.en: The play drew us into an Alice-in-Wonderland world of shifting doors.
entries.zh: 这出话剧将我们带入了一个门扉不停变换的梦幻世界。

entries.en: The manager's alienative tone made the volunteers reluctant to return.
entries.zh: 经理使人疏离的语气让志愿者们不愿再来。

entries.en: The sculptor added an aliferous figure to the top of the fountain.
entries.zh: 雕塑家在喷泉顶部添了一个长着翅膀的人物造像。

entries.en: The aliped messenger hovered above the clouds in the mural.
entries.zh: 壁画中，那个翼足信使悬在云层上方。

entries.en: The illustrator marked the alisphenoidal region in a contrasting colour.
entries.zh: 插画师用对比色标出了蝶骨大翼区域。

entries.meaningZh: 不举行圣餐仪式的〔宗教〕
entries.en: The historian compared aliturgical days in two old church calendars.
entries.zh: 历史学家比较了两部教会旧历中不举行圣餐仪式的日子。

entries.en: The textile designer requested an alkalifast dye for the trial.
entries.zh: 纺织设计师要求用一种耐碱染料进行试验。

entries.en: The chemist labelled the alkaliferous sample before sealing the jar.
entries.zh: 化学研究人员在封罐之前给含碱样本贴上了标签。

entries.en: The laboratory repeated the alkalimetric determination with a fresh indicator.
entries.zh: 实验室用新的指示剂重新进行了碱量滴定测定。

entries.en: An alkalinous residue remained at the bottom of the flask.
entries.zh: 烧瓶底部留有碱性残渣。

entries.en: The engineer ordered alkaliproof lining for the storage tank.
entries.zh: 工程师为储罐订购了耐碱衬里。

entries.en: The chemist separated the alkylable fraction from the rest of the mixture.
entries.zh: 化学研究人员将可烷基化的部分从其余混合物中分离出来。

entries.en: The diagram highlights an alkylatable site on the molecular structure.
entries.zh: 图中突出标示了分子结构上一个可烷基化的位点。

entries.en: The chemist marked the alkynyl group in blue on her sketch.
entries.zh: 化学研究人员在她的草图上用蓝色标出了炔基。

entries.en: The trailer promised an all-action adventure with scarcely a quiet moment.
entries.zh: 预告片预示着一场充满打斗动作、几乎没有安静时刻的冒险。

entries.en: The company announced an all-Canada tour rather than an international series.
entries.zh: 公司宣布了一次仅限加拿大境内的巡演，而不是国际系列演出。

entries.en: Her all-caps message looked urgent even before I read it.
entries.zh: 还没读内容，她那条全部大写的消息就显得很紧急。

entries.en: The novel's all-conquering hero finally meets an opponent he cannot defeat.
entries.zh: 小说中那个所向无敌的英雄终于遇到了无法击败的对手。

entries.en: The restoration became an all-consuming project that left little time for visitors.
entries.zh: 修复工作变成了一项极其耗时的工程，几乎没留下接待访客的时间。

entries.en: She chose all-cotton sheets after comparing the fabric labels.
entries.zh: 她比较织物标签后，选择了全棉床单。

entries.en: An all-day workshop kept the meeting room occupied until evening.
entries.zh: 一场全天实践班一直占用着会议室，直到傍晚。

entries.en: The studio replaced its old tape setup with an all-digital system.
entries.zh: 录音室用一套全数字系统替换了旧的磁带设备。

entries.en: The brochure describes an all-electric house without a gas connection.
entries.zh: 宣传册介绍了一栋不接燃气的全电气化住宅。

entries.en: The museum contrasted an all-electronic calculator with an older mechanical model.
entries.zh: 博物馆将一台全电子计算器与一个更早的机械型号作了对比。

entries.en: The prize included an all-expense trip to the annual conference.
entries.zh: 奖品包括一趟费用全包的年度会议之旅。

entries.en: The curator moved the all-glass sculpture away from the busy doorway.
entries.zh: 策展人把那件全玻璃雕塑移离了人来人往的门口。

entries.en: The director called an all-hands meeting after the project schedule changed.
entries.zh: 项目日程改变后，主管召集了一次全体人员会议。

entries.en: Before booking, we asked for an all-in price in writing.
entries.zh: 预订前，我们要求对方书面提供包含一切费用的价格。

entries.en: The photograph shows an all-male choir assembled beside the piano.
entries.zh: 照片上，一支全男声合唱团聚集在钢琴旁。

entries.en: He questioned the all-natural claim on the brightly coloured snack packet.
entries.zh: 他对那个色彩鲜艳的零食包装上纯天然的宣传提出了质疑。

entries.en: The diagram compares an all-optical link with the older electronic connection.
entries.zh: 图中将一条全光链路与较早的电子连接作了比较。

entries.en: The curtain's all-over floral pattern made the small room feel busy.
entries.zh: 窗帘上的满幅花卉图案让这个小房间显得有些纷杂。

entries.meaningZh: 浑身不舒服的〔非正式，旧用〕
entries.en: I felt all-overish and left the party before the speeches started.
entries.zh: 我浑身不舒服，在讲话开始前就离开了聚会。

entries.en: An all-party committee examined the proposal before the public hearing.
entries.zh: 一个由各党派组成的委员会在公开听证会前审查了那份提案。

entries.en: The engineer adjusted the all-pass filter before recording the signal again.
entries.zh: 工程师调整了全通滤波器，然后再次记录信号。

entries.en: An all-pervading fear shaped the characters' choices throughout the novel.
entries.zh: 一种普遍存在的恐惧影响着整部小说中人物们的选择。

entries.en: The novel conveys an all-pervasive unease through its ordinary domestic scenes.
entries.zh: 小说通过寻常的家庭场景传达出一种遍及各方面的不安。

entries.meaningZh: 全在大英帝国版图内的〔历史用语〕
entries.en: The novel's characters argued over a proposed all-red shipping route.
entries.zh: 小说中的人物为一条拟议中的、全在大英帝国版图内的航运路线争论不休。

entries.en: The neighbours regarded him as an all-right fellow despite his blunt manners.
entries.zh: 尽管他举止直率，邻居们还是认为他是个诚实可靠的人。

entries.en: She packed an all-season jacket for the journey across several regions.
entries.zh: 她带上了一件四季可穿的夹克，准备踏上跨越几个地区的旅程。

entries.en: The club presented plans for an all-seater stadium at the meeting.
entries.zh: 俱乐部在会上展示了一座全坐席体育场的规划。

entries.en: Her all-sided assessment considered the costs as well as the possible benefits.
entries.zh: 她全面的评估既考虑了成本，也考虑了可能的收益。
